sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 20 December 2024, pitch SYN-SYNCP000040-P1 was put before Blue Ridge Medical Group 040 on behalf of SEQIRUS.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 4.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Influenza preferred-position minimum of 90 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
